title: Structure and stability of N7 cluster
authors: Qian-Shu Li, Xu-Guang Hu, Wen-Guo Xu

bond_params.units_as_printed: nm in paper, converted to Angstrom by x10
bond_params.shape: described as a derivative of the N6 prismane (Engelke) with an extra substituent atom; strained (some bond angles <90 deg)

species.notes: Genuine local minimum at UHF and B3LYP levels (0 imaginary freqs). B3LYP total energy -382.7819 au (0 imaginary). Higher in energy than isomer 2.

bond_params.shape: second derivative of the N6 prismane (Engelke), analogous to isomer 1

species.notes: Genuine local minimum (0 imaginary), B3LYP total energy -382.8398 au. Lowest vibrational freq 445(b1) cm-1 at UHF.

bond_params.shape: not otherwise described geometrically beyond bond table

species.notes: NOT a true minimum: 2 imaginary frequencies (393i, 278i cm-1 at UHF; 146i, 72i cm-1 at B3LYP) -- a genuine saddle point despite being lower in energy than isomers 1,2. B3LYP total energy -382.9088 au. Include for completeness but flag as unstable.

bond_params.shape: branched, R67 length (1.214 A) close to N2H2 double-bond character

species.notes: Genuine local minimum (0 imaginary at UHF and B3LYP), B3LYP total energy -382.8261 au. Paper: 'possible candidate of stable N7 isomers'.

species.method: UHF/6-31G* (only level where it exists as a stationary point)
species.notes: IMPORTANT: dissociates into N2 + N3 + N2 upon reoptimization at UMP2/6-31G* and B3LYP/6-31G* levels -- not a real bound N7 structure except as a UHF-level artifact. Included per instructions (paper does report a geometry) but should likely be EXCLUDED from any relaxation/comparison pool, or treated purely as a historical curiosity.

bond_params.shape: hexaazabenzene-like N6 ring (three N up, three N down, alternating) capped by a 7th N atom above the ring center -- described as a triradical

species.suggested_build: UNKNOWN (ring + apical cap, no direct geom.py match; closest existing shape functions do not cover a capped 6-ring)
species.notes: Genuine local minimum at BOTH UHF and B3LYP levels (0 imaginary; lowest freq 461(e) cm-1 UHF, 377(a2) cm-1 B3LYP) despite quartet (S=3/2) spin state -- notable, paper calls this 'an interesting result'. B3LYP total energy -382.7596 au.

bond_params.shape: twisted open-chain (zigzag); terminal bonds close to N2 triple-bond length (1.094 A), central region hypervalent-like

species.notes: GLOBAL MINIMUM of this paper's N7 study (lowest energy of all 7 isomers considered, all real vibrational frequencies). B3LYP total energy -383.0303 au. Central angle ~105-112 deg consistent with sp3 central N.

bond_params.shape: twisted open-chain, C2 symmetry-broken variant of iso7_Cs

species.notes: Paper reports this as numerically near-identical to N7_iso7_Cs_chain (same bond lengths/angles to given precision, same total energy -383.0303 au, nearly identical nuclear repulsion energy) -- essentially the same structure under two symmetry labels. Keep as separate entry per paper's own distinction but flag for likely dedup with iso7_Cs during centralized processing.
